assessment_scope: origin/main repository evidence only; no economic result, private warehouse, live QuestDB, broker account, or order interface was read

status_vocabulary.AVAILABLE: required contract and bounded coverage evidence are present
status_vocabulary.PARTIAL: some schema or implementation exists but the required contract or coverage is incomplete
status_vocabulary.UNVERIFIED: the repository does not prove the required historical coverage
status_vocabulary.MISSING: the required contract or data is absent from the assessed scope

decision_reason: repository schemas and validators do not bind the required historical exact-contract bars, BBO, PIT curve inputs, official calendar, roll continuity, and effective fee coverage

items.required_coverage: all scheduled one-minute components for each candidate day-session bar and frozen sample cell
items.gap: QuestDB can aggregate ticks, but no immutable exact-contract 1-minute history, coverage receipt, or gap inventory is bound in the repository

items.purpose: causal side-aware primary/stress fills and executable spread
items.required_coverage: a qualifying real BBO for at least 99% of all candidate, roll, exit, and paired-baseline target events in every product/fold
items.gap: tick/BBO fields exist, but no immutable historical coverage, freshness, restart continuity, or exact-contract alignment receipt is present; VerifiedTick contains only level one

items.purpose: DAILY_PIT_OI_MAIN, roll-safe index, 21/63-day trend, and 20-day carry
items.required_coverage: 100% of consecutive official-day inputs required by every frozen sample cell and warmup
items.gap: schemas and roll code exist, but the source view is explicitly unverified input and no raw all-contract history or coverage receipt is stored in the repository

items.purpose: official TradingDay attribution, scheduled 15-minute bars, holidays, recesses, and next legal quote
items.required_coverage: 100% of frozen sample days and warmup, including revisions and exceptional sessions
items.gap: calendar schema and validation code exist, but no signed historical calendar/session source artifact covering the candidate sample is present

items.purpose: tick value, multiplier, LTD, delivery ordering, exact mapping, and two-leg roll
items.required_coverage: 100% of exact contracts selected or held in every frozen sample cell
items.gap: static product specs and selection logic exist, but exact-contract effective-history, exceptional changes, and roll continuity receipts are not bound

items.purpose: OPEN, CLOSE, and CLOSE_TODAY all-in cost for candidate and paired baseline
items.required_coverage: 100% of candidate, exit, roll, and paired-baseline simulated fills
items.gap: fee semantics are documented as fail-closed, but the historically effective fee statements and complete close-today binding are not present

items.purpose: prove provider, acquisition time, immutable bytes, PIT visibility, gaps, and revisions
items.required_coverage: every daily, calendar, spec, fee, bar, and quote source used by the replay
items.gap: generic manifest primitives exist, but no candidate-specific immutable source manifest or revision/gap inventory has been bound

forbidden_gap_substitutions: continuous-main prices as executable prices or PnL authority
bar close or next bar open as an ideal fill
synthetic 1-second or tick paths as economic evidence
forward-filled missing bars, quotes, sessions, specs, or PIT values
allowed_next_action: bounded read-only binding of already existing data and coverage receipts to the frozen requirements; no collector, service, queue, database, or platform build
